name: 采集 Facebook 帖子数据

hint.zh: 只读最近发的，一页是主页往下滚一屏；用 API 连接的账号不受影响。页数越多越像脚本，容易被平台警告；更早的帖子在账号卡片上点「立即采集」补全。
hint.en: Reads only the latest posts; a page is one screen of the profile; accounts connected through the API are unaffected. More pages look more like a script and may get a platform warning; click "Collect now" on the account card to fill in older posts.
